On the calendar

Upcoming Gatherings

Five ways to show up this summer. All welcome — member or not for your first visit.

12 July 2026
Potluck

Summer Potluck & Backyard Movie Night

Riverside Park Pavilion, West Side

Our biggest gathering of the summer. Spread a blanket on the grass, lay out your best dish, and stay through sunset for an outdoor screening of Tampopo — the greatest film ever made about food, noodles, and the ache of desire. This is BYOB, BYOBlanket, and bring enough to share. Kids and dogs warmly welcome.

6:00 PM · Film at dark (~9 PM) RSVP →
19 July 2026
Skill Share

Sourdough from Scratch with Rosa Figueroa

The Common Kitchen · 48 Elm Street

Rosa learned to make sourdough from her grandmother in Oaxaca and has been refining the recipe ever since. You'll mix, fold, and shape your own loaf. Take home your own active starter and a printed recipe card. Beginners especially encouraged.

10:00 AM – 1:00 PM RSVP →
2 Aug 2026
Volunteer Day

Seed Library & Community Garden Walk

Elm Street Community Garden

Declan Walsh leads a slow walk through the 40-plot community garden, introducing growers and their plants. Afterwards: open the seed library for summer trades. Bring any saved seeds to donate; leave with a handful of something new. Gloves and coffee provided.

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM RSVP →
9 Aug 2026
Reading Group

Reading Circle: Braiding Sweetgrass by Robin Wall Kimmerer

Portsmith Branch Library, Reading Room B

Priya Nakamura facilitates our summer title — a braided meditation on Indigenous plant knowledge, the grammar of animacy, and what it means to live in gratitude. Chapters 1–12 for this session. Extra copies available at the library front desk. Tea provided.

6:30 PM – 8:30 PM RSVP →
23 Aug 2026
Volunteer Day

Street Mural Volunteer Day — Caldera & 5th

Corner of Caldera Avenue & 5th Street

The long blank wall at Caldera & 5th is getting a neighborhood mural, designed by local artist and Common Table member Rosa Figueroa. We need painters, coffee runners, music providers, and anyone willing to hold a roller for a few hours. No artistic experience required — just enthusiasm and clothes you don't mind getting paint on. Lunch will be a potluck on the sidewalk. Come for an hour or stay all day.

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (drop in anytime) RSVP →
